title: Issues with Private Data Source Connect (PDC) in AWS US East (OH)

updates.body: Between 09:38 and 10:45 UTC on 9 October 2026, customers using Private Data Source Connect (PDC) in the AWS US East (OH) - prod-us-east-2 Grafana Cloud Region, experienced failed or timed-out data source queries. This has been fully resolved and all services are operating normally.

title: Phone call notifications to numbers in Russia and Kazakhstan are blocked

updates.body:
Phone call notifications to numbers in Russia and Kazakhstan are currently blocked. We are working to resolve the issue.
As SMS support is limited in these countries, we recommend using mobile push notifications as an alternative.

We do not currently have an estimated resolution time. We will provide further updates as more information becomes available.
